lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Kiko, you’re the acting editor-in-chief now.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Did Enzo send you Paragon’s drive?

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: I... I don't have access to the account, Ma'am.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: But he gave me a flash drive.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Check it using the Office Computer.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: The whistleblower file should be there.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Check the flash drive on the Office Computer.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: We need to know what's in that whistleblower file before Mr. Reyes comes back.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Good work getting that transcript cleaned up.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: We still have a long way to go before NSPC, but this buys us time.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Keep working on the publication issue.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Santos
lines.text: Don't let Mr. Reyes catch us unprepared.
